_doc: Cases for test-e2e/install.test.mjs, read from this block directory (never installed into projects). The defaults case always runs; "cases" add param sets ({name, params, dependencyParams?}); registryDependencies are installed first by `kit install` itself (from blocks/, with dependencyParams passed as --param <dependency>.<name>=<value>). "conflicts" entries write "setup" files into a fresh project, expect the dry run to exit 1 with the listed conflicts, then install with "resolve" ({params?, on_conflict?}) and expect verify to pass. "chains" install several blocks into one project.
